assertion: A event of type "Heatwave" exists, described as "European heatwave in June".

evidence_cited: France has said it recorded an increase of more than 2,000 deaths during the last week of a record-breaking European heatwave in June as forecasters warn of further extreme temperatures on the continent in the next few days. || France saw its hottest day ever on average country-wide on 24 June, with temperatures hitting almost 41C in Paris and half the nation placed under a red heat alert. || This summer's record-breaking temperatures have already proved particularly deadly.

assertion: A event of type "ExtremeWeatherForecast" exists, described as "Forecast for extreme weather in Europe".
